history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration work on a detailed implementation plan, clarify resource estimation, develop an outreach component and conduct a review of efficiency initiatives for the refined ICT strategy in line with General Assembly resolutions.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. In the report of the Secretary-General on the status of implementation of the information and communications technology strategy for the United Nations (A/80/558), an implementation plan is detailed in annex I and efficiency initiatives are reviewed (paras. 16, 37, 42 and 62, and table 7).
history.board_assessment: Given that an implementation plan is detailed in the report of the Secretary-General on the status of implementation of the information and communications technology strategy for the United Nations (A/80/558), and that the Department of Operational Support is conducting activities to promote awareness of human resources and vendor opportunities, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
